cues: The more you dilute, the more it ionises.
A hundred times more dilute means ten times more ionised, because alpha goes as the square root of the dilution.
The law holds for weak electrolytes only.
Strong electrolytes like sodium chloride are fully ionised already, so there is no equilibrium to shift.
